messages:
maria: hey team, kicking off the marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure — need a quick sync on the initial setup and legal packaging. who owns the AMI/docs + trial SKU mapping?
kevin: I can own AMI + publisher account bits for AWS. will need the final logo + short description from product.
rachel: I’ll take GCP image + billing mapping. quick Q: do we want a single trial SKU across clouds or cloud-specific trial SKUs?
maria: prefer a single SKU if billing entitlements can map cleanly, otherwise cloud-specific. devon, any constraints from marketing/visibility?
devon: single SKU simplifies marketing, but Azure marketplace needs separate plan ids for meter. could be a blocker for a single-SKU approach.
kevin: noted. I’ll prototype a single-SKU flow and flag Azure differences.
maria: legal-bot, any outstanding EULA/localization or data residency asks for these marketplaces?
legal-bot: FYI: AWS requires localized EULA for FR/DE/ES if we enable public listing in those regions. Azure has additional reseller language in the publisher agreement. recommend final EULA + list of regions by EOD Tue.
rachel: thanks — I’ll scope localization effort. also need to confirm SSO/SCIM provisioning for trial accounts.
devon: product: we want to surface an "Enterprise trial" option with 14 days and auto-conversion CTA. UX owners say we need a 1-line capabilities bullet for listing (<=140 chars).
maria: can someone drop the 140-char blurb here? I can iterate.
kevin: "Redwood Inference: low-latency LLM inference with predictable pricing and dedicated deployment options." (140c?)
rachel: short and good. I counted ~95 chars, good margin.
maria: perfect. kevin, when you spin up the AMI, pls include a README with the manifest and the image checksum. Use this snippet for manifest generation:```bash
./generate_manifest --image ./redwood-ami-2026.img --out manifest.json --sha256
```
kevin: copied. I’ll post the manifest + checksum to the publisher portal and ping infra for artifact upload.
legal-bot: also attach the signed MSA hash to the listing artifacts or the publisher will reject.
devon: timeline check — can we aim for staging publish by next Wed?
maria: realistic?
kevin: yes for AWS/GCP if no legal surprises. Azure might be +3 days for plan mapping.
rachel: I’ll start billing mapping and test entitlements in GCP staging today. will flag any blockers by EOD.
maria: awesome — action items: kevin = AMI + manifest + AWS publish; rachel = GCP image + billing mapping; devon = finalize 140c blurb + visibility plan; legal-bot = confirm EULA localization list. updating the tracker now, will DM follow-ups. :thumbsup:
